title: Typewriter
description: The liner credits for the Beatles' Revolver on a sheet of cream bond rolled into a typewriter reduced to its platen and a red ribbon guide. Every key bites the paper with its own worn, uneven ink; Return throws the carriage home and rolls the platen.
intent: The machine pared back to the paper, the platen and the ribbon so the strike is the subject: real strikes on real paper, every letter landing a little differently, the carriage moving with weight.
